jq.name: the workflow plugin is a js-script job plugin that requires script
jq.expr: plugin | .name == "workflow" and .job == true and .script_runtime == "js" and (.input_schema.required | index("script") != null) and .instructions == "plugins/workflow/TOOL.md" and .limits.wall_clock_secs <= 900

jq.name: the caller template names only the read-only worker and ships dynamic as check (a pack may not ship run)
the worker is read-only with no network and no session history
TOOL.md states the step-function contract
jq.expr: .assets["plugins/workflow/TOOL.md"] | contains("module.exports") and contains("(input) => output") and contains("job_calls") and contains("effects")
